//: Type-checks the Playwright E2E suite (tests/e2e/**) and playwright.config.ts.
Kept separate from tsconfig.json because these files run under Node via
the Playwright test runner, not Vite/Vitest — they need @playwright/test's
and Node's ambient types, which conflict with the browser-facing types in
src/ (see nodeTestShims.d.ts in src/shared for why Node's global
`setTimeout` override isn't added to the main program). A separate tsc
program keeps the two from merging.
